description: Use this when the user asks which cadastral parcel (parcelle cadastrale, plot of land) is at an address or point in France, its reference (commune, section, number) and cadastral area, or which local urban plan zone applies there (PLU or PLUi zoning: zone label, type such as U, AU, A or N, and the plan document), for example before buying land or a house or before a building project. Reads the open data of the French cadastre (DGFiP) and of the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme. Shows the parcel on a map with GeoJSON and KML downloads. France only. Never returns owners or property sales. The zone is not a building permit decision. Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Give the place as the user names it (place name, address or coordinates): this tool locates it, so find_places is not needed first. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file.
